newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Peru to buy four June gas oil cargoes - Petroperu.
newsitem.headline: Peru to buy four June gas oil cargoes - Petroperu.

text.p: Peru state-owned oil company Petroperu is planning to buy 800,000 barrels of gasoil in June via purchase tenders, a Petroperu official said Wednesday.

The company earlier this week issued a tender for one 200,000-barrel cargo for delivery in the first week of June and is planning to tender for three more for delivery in the second, third and fourth week later today, he added.
Peru is a regular gasoil buyer, and requires 45 minimum cetane and 0.5-1.0 percent sulphur.
